title: In five model Green's functions, DOISST v2.1 steps hide 15-21% of the 1982-2022 SST pattern effect by near-uniform false warming; the 2018 OI v2 step makes 2001-2022 AMIP feedback more negative
abstract: Question: how much do the known false steps in NOAA DOISST v2.1 (warm steps in 2005 and 2020) and in NOAA OI SST v2, the post-1981 source of the PCMDI-AMIP forcing (a cold Southern Hemisphere step in mid-2018), change the radiative feedback that atmosphere models give for the observed SST pattern? Approach: we read the Green's functions (dN/dSST) of CAM5, CanESM5, ECHAM6, GFDL-AM4 and HadAM3 (plus CAM4 and other variants as checks) from the GFMIP protocol data with a new byte-range JLD2/HDF5 reader. We applied them to monthly 5-degree SST anomalies (60S-60N, fixed ice-free mask) of DOISST, two step-corrected DOISST versions, OI v2 (identical to PCMDI-AMIP 1.1.9 here), OI v2 with the 2018 step removed, ERSSTv5, COBE-SST2, HadISST1 and ESA CCI. Feedback is the trend of N divided by the trend of the 60S-60N SST, and the pattern term is this feedback minus the uniform-warming value. Results: over 1982-2022, the DOISST pattern term is -0.50 W m-2 K-1 and the corrected terms are -0.59 to -0.63 (Delta +0.09, 95% interval +0.02 to +0.18, and +0.13, interval +0.04 to +0.26). The cause is dilution: the DOISST steps have a near-uniform radiative signature (step N/SST -1.1 to -1.8 against -1.44 for uniform warming), so their false warming moves the feedback toward the uniform value. Their regional maxima in the east Pacific and the Southern Ocean have little weight. In 21-year windows that end in 2010-2013, DOISST hides 29% of the pattern effect, and it shows a 35-38% smaller rise of the feedback to the 2001-2022 windows. The 2018 OI v2 step has a dipole pattern. It makes the 2001-2022 feedback of OI v2 and AMIP 1.1.9 more negative by 0.21 (five models -0.13 to -0.25; references -0.10 to -0.23). Limitations: the feedback is per K of 60S-60N SST, the Green's functions are linear and differ between models by a factor of about 3, the correction sizes are uncertain, and the in situ products differ among themselves by 0.24 in the pattern term.

display.caption: Green's-function pattern term (feedback minus uniform-warming feedback, per K of 60S-60N SST) for nine SST versions, 1982-2022 and 2001-2022. Open symbols: five atmosphere models; bars: 5-model mean. DOISST (orange) is less negative than its step-corrected versions (blue) in 1982-2022; removing the 2018 OI v2 step (green against violet) makes 2001-2022 less negative.

Radiative signature of product steps: step in Green's-function N against step in 60S-60N mean SST (5-model mean, bars: model range). The DOISST 2005 and 2020 steps (orange) lie near the uniform-warming line, so they dilute the pattern effect; the OI v2 2018 step (violet) lies far from it, so it acts through its pattern.

(a) Mean Green's function of five models per unit area; (b) DOISST minus step-corrected DOISST 1982-2022 trend; (c) contribution of (b) to the N trend, largest in the warm pool and Indian Ocean; (d) OI v2 (= AMIPII) step at 2018-06 against the in situ mean.
